admissibility_vs_training.statement: Runtime admissibility is stricter than historical training ingestion. Invalid runtime inputs are rejected before they enter the model preprocessing path. For accepted finite model-ready inputs, the B23 preprocessing semantics match the frozen training feature path.
admissibility_vs_training.training_historical_nonfinite_fill: scripts.mmwave_m_pv2_candidate_training._feature_matrix filled non-finite assembled values with zeros
admissibility_vs_training.runtime_nonfinite_policy: Stage 0 fail-closed NON_FINITE_INPUT; no zero-fill physiology

window_construction: fixed causal 30 s / 300 samples; fewer than 300 samples fail closed
trace_mask_semantics: 1=valid finite sample, 0=invalid; retained as model input; not interpolated
invalid_value_handling: Stage 0 rejects non-finite required fields; no physiology fill
trace_normalization: z-score with TRAIN trace mean/std from frozen scaler; apply once
scale_feature_computation: canonical R2 F2-map SCALE_NAMES (12) via extract_feature_candidates / _feature_arrays; z-scored with TRAIN scale mean/std
quality_feature_computation: canonical R2 F3 QUALITY_NAMES (9) via extract_feature_candidates / _feature_arrays; z-scored with TRAIN quality mean/std
